title: Lutos, irrigated, Banat plain, mid-September
rationale: Lutos is in suitable_classes for all five candidates, so grau_toamna is a safe top pick (lutos suitable, Bărăgan/south window 10-01 → 10-20 inside the horizon). rapita_toamna is excluded on the calendar, not on the soil: its windows for this zone — 'Câmpia Română și Câmpia Banatului' 09-01 → 09-10 and 'estul, vestul și nordul țării' 09-01 → 09-10 — both closed before 2026-09-13, and the national hybrid window 08-20 → 08-31 closed too. The only rapeseed window still open on the case date is 'sudul țării' 09-05 → 09-15, and Lovrin (Timiș, Banat) is not in the south.
